greeting: High Tide Councilor on comms. Stage 6: Rising Tide. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Depths of Mystery. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I saw gravity file for overtime in this sector. Management approved.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Accept Tide's allegiance.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Accept Tide's allegiance; Learn of the Crystal of Industry; Plan the journey to Obsidian. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Help rebuild Tide and learn of the next Crystal. Immediate move: Accept Tide's allegiance.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 6 resolved: Rising Tide. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Epilogue Transition.
rumor: Divers found a gate marked with the same sigil as the palace engine.
People keep repeating one clue from Rising Tide: 'Plan the journey to Obsidian'.
I met my future self and we argued about shoe durability.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn tide is calm enough for precision dives. Best window for route checks.
dialog.time_noon: Noon currents fight each other in the trench. Anchor and communicate.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk visibility drops fast underwater. Stay on beacon chain.
dialog.time_night: Night tide carries deep-song interference. Confirm orders twice.

party_reactions.kade: High Tide Councilor sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for High Tide Councilor accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: High Tide Councilor talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Same plan as always: adapt, push, survive, repeat.
